title: Robot vacuum POV (lifelike video made only with code)
how: No AI video model, no 3D package, no textures, no recordings. src/scene.h models the flat procedurally in C++, src/render.metal is a path tracer in one Metal compute kernel (hardware ray tracing, runtime-compiled), src/path.h simulates the robot and its camera, src/main.mm does lens/sensor post-processing and pipes frames to ffmpeg, src/audio.py synthesises the sound from the event timeline with numpy/scipy.
render: ./render.sh renders/v1.mp4 36   (about 45 min on the M5; segments in work/seg are resumable)
checks: ./robovac --collide   (route vs. furniture);  ./robovac --eye x y z --at x y z --frames dir   (free camera stills);  --mode 1..5 debug views
